subject: Fix TSAN compatibility for module loading (#3257)
reason: The change is a sanitizer-compatibility build fix with no behaviour change on regular builds: it defines VALKEY_THREAD_SANITIZER and uses it only to (a) exclude RTLD_DEEPBIND from dlopen in moduleLoad when compiling under TSAN, mirroring the existing ASAN exclusion, and (b) mark the string2ll ifunc resolver no_sanitize("thread") so TSAN skips instrumenting pre-init code. On non-TSAN builds the macro is undefined and the attribute has no effect, so module loading flags and string2ll behaviour are identical to the parent; nothing a fuzzer scenario runs against normal binaries can reach or distin
